equipment_type: CO2 sensor probe (CO2, humidity, temperature, pressure)
applies_to: E+E EE872 CO2 probes with the BACnet MS/TP output: EE872-M10 (CO2 only) and EE872-M13 (CO2 plus temperature, humidity and pressure).
summary: The EE872 is a CO2 probe that runs as a BACnet MS/TP master with six Analog Inputs. The M13 version adds temperature, humidity, ambient pressure and dew point to the CO2 values; on the M10 those four objects exist but report NaN with Reliability NO_SENSOR.
notes: Object list from the PICS sections 11-12 (v1.1, dated 10.03.2021).
On M10 probes the unsupported objects have Present_Value NaN, Event_State FAULT and Reliability NO_SENSOR.
All objects are read-only except Present_Value while Out_Of_Service is true.

integration.summary: Set a unique device instance and MAC address, then poll AI 4 for CO2. M13 probes also give temperature, humidity and pressure.
setup: Device instance (0-4194302) and device name are writable and kept in non-volatile memory; the default name is the model plus 8 unique characters.
RS485 settings are one writable string property, default "38400-8n1"; baud 9600-115200, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit fixed.
Max Master is writable, up to 127.
ReinitializeDevice and DeviceCommunicationControl need the password printed in the PICS.
gotchas: COV reporting stays off until COV_Increment is set; COV messages are broadcast (no subscription list).
On the M10, AI 0-3 read NaN with a FAULT event state; don't alarm on them.
